notes.title: The EVIL update!
notes.content:
This update addresses a lot of things the community has discussed about Einlanzer. There are fairly large changes to playing the game in a dishonorable way. Most specifically, the "Vile" tier of weapons that are only accessible by being dishonorable are now substantially better. Also, a side quest leading to a truly powerful weapon only accessible by being consistently dishonorable has been added to the game. This weapon is a counter to the Excalibur--the extremely powerful weapon you can obtain by being consistently honorable. Head down to the Abyss and look for a new skeleton NPC to start the quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27377919/61ff51daa64e141e6b08171ae0312d056b35f7c8.jpg[/img]
Don't expect him to want to talk to you if you're a goody-two-shoes....

One other major late-game improvement is the ability to travel to Canaan and the Abyss even when you're right before the final boss. Now, you don't have to worry about anything being missing or inaccessible with your final boss save file.

Some other fairly major changes have been made with this update and have been listed in detail below.

[list]
[*]Improved "Void" weapons (less inaccurate now)
[*]Improved "Vile" weapons (HP and Luck stat drain was reduced by 50%)
[*]Added new ultimate evil weapon to counter the ultimate good weapon Excalibur
[*]Abyss and Canaan are now accessible even when ready for final battle
[*]Added new skeleton NPC to Abyss hub
[*]Added new short side quest in Abyss accessible by talking to new NPC in Abyss hub
[*]Added new boss battle related to new side quest
[*]Changed the wording on the item "Snow Gem" to more clearly state that it is a spell and should only be used on magic users.
[/list]


As always, please take a moment to write a review for Einlanzer. It helps tremendously!

Happy adventuring, Swordbearers!

-Andrew Ryan Henke
Nostalgia Addict Games

notes.title: Einlanzer update!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

A new update for Einlanzer is here!

In this patch, a few things the community has been asking for has been implemented. First, all skills and magic have been rebalanced so the Defense and Magic Defense stats simply do more. You will see this reflected mostly in how much damage tanky heros take. However, tanky enemies will take less damage from your attacks as well!

Next, every major dungeon now has a "fast-travel" option once the dungeon is completed. You will never have to pointlessly trudge back through a dungeon again after defeating the boss unless you want to.

Lastly, I was shocked to hear players who defeated the extreme difficulty secret last boss Saul-Rious say he wasn't *that* hard. Well... for you folks out there who said that... prepare to have your butts handed to you by Saul-Rious (Prime). Once you defeat Saul-Rious once then travel back to him again, you'll have the option to challenge Saul-Rious (Prime) who has more attacks, gets two turns every round, and higher stats across the board. Good luck! *evil laugh commences*

Update Specifics
[list]
[*]Rebalanced all skills and magic so defense and magic defense are more effective
[*]New insane difficulty secret final boss Saul-Rious
[*]Fast-travel option in every major dungeon
[/list]

notes.title: Update v.1.215
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Welcome to Einlanzer version 1.215!  This isn't a major update. It mostly fixes a few bugs and/or suggestions from the discussions board. There are a couple small gameplay additions as well, though.

Changes for Einlanzer v.1.215

[list]
    [*]There is a new hidden area accessible as soon as you have your ship. It is on the far east side of the map. Look for an igloo on a snowy island.
    [*]New weapon! Obtained from the igloo mentioned above, you can find a new weapon called "Shatter." This is a spear that has a unique effect. It has a 25% chance of inflicting the "Frostbite" status effect on anyone it hits. This status effect makes a target take DOUBLE physical damage and have 1/2 speed. This weapon can be a valid strategic choice through the whole game.
    [*]There is a new, additional story event for Ratt when he visits the charred remains of his house south of Alabaster. The new event is only accessible after achieving Ascension in Canaan.
    [*]Obtained from the story event mentioned above, there is a new accessory called "Mother's Momento." This unique accessory lowers damage from Fire, Ice, and Lit damage by 33%, protects against instant death attacks and spells, and raises the Magic Def, Luck, and HP stats.
    [*]The difficulty of the two battles at the top of Tier Tower have been lowered (Master Tierian Mages and General Baiz). Both enemy types have had their speed, Attack, Magic Attack, and HP lowered slightly.
    [*]Lastly, a couple small typos have been fixed in this version.
[/list]

Please don't hesitate to post any concerns or glitches in the discussion boards. I will do my best to address and fix any and all concerns mentioned.

As always, please take a moment to review Einlanzer on Steam. It helps tremendously.

Happy adventuring!
-Andrew Ryan Henke

notes.title: April Fool's Calendar Event, New Side Quest, New Features, and more!
notes.content:
Welcome to Einlanzer version 1.212!

[h1]Foolish Fool's Day calendar event[/h1]
Riddari's annual Foolish Fool's Day Festival is here! A brand new foolish event has been added for this year's holiday with unique rewards that are ONLY available during THIS YEAR'S event! Next year will have new unique prizes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/a7056fd7a7636863b1b876a00b96b2d14fdcb83e.png[/img]

The event ends at midnight EST on April 8th, so go talk to the jester in Riddari to play before this calendar event is over!

[h1]Updates with v.1.212[/h1]
You spoke and we listened! Based on player feedback, there are several gameplay updates with this patch. Every change is detailed below.

[h1]New Sidequest and items![/h1]
There is a brand new side quest available in the town of God's Grove. Go in the building on the north side of town to begin the quest. The reward will be a brand new purchasable, usable item type that could potentially drastically change your strategy in battle!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/fb038b5a7adc3ad68b51308255bceb002493a703.jpg[/img]

I have another sidequest in the works right now that will take you to an ancient, buried Fusilier fort. Expect it to be done around mid-April. Players said they wanted more side quests! :-)

[h1]Quick World Map Button[/h1]
Einlanzer now has a button/key that lets you instantly look at the world map (Lanzer's realm) without having to fumble with the menu and key items. Thank you player unknown_zzz for the suggestion!
[list]
[*]Steam Controller/Keyboard version: the letter V or TAB on your keybard, or the < button on your Steam Controller.
[*]PC Gamepad version: the letter A on your keyboard or button 4 on your pc gamepad by default.
[/list]
Also, a couple lines of text are added through the early part of the game to let players know that they can use the quick world map button. These happen when you first get the world map from the blacksmith in Sea Breeze, when the shipbuilder sends you off to Riddari in Elnae, and when you first get your sailing ship. Also, The controls graphics you see when you start a new game have been updated to show the new "Instant World Map" buttons/keys.

[h1]Stat Explanation screen[/h1]
One player on the discussion board said they wanted a detailed explanation of all the stats from the menu. I agreed this was an excellent addition, especially for how RP, percentage stat increasing items, and the Luck stat works.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/d624153e0aca01af6d17ff7a5360d9b78705c2e7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Full Heal spell buffed[/h1]
Alice's spell "Full Heal" had little use before. It seemed to always make more sense just to cast a strong "Recovery" spell. Now, "Full Heal" will not only give the target 100% of their HP, but it will also heal most status effects! It's not *quite* as thorough as a "Cure II" spell, but it does eliminate most status effects.

notes.title: Foolish Fool's Day Calendar Event! (and other update info)
notes.content:
[h1]April Fool's Calendar Event[/h1]
Hello, adventurers! It's almost time for the annual Foolish Fool's Day festival!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/a7056fd7a7636863b1b876a00b96b2d14fdcb83e.png[/img]

The kingdom of Riddari throws this yearly holiday to celebrate all things crazy, foolish, and bizarre! The event will yield unique, exclusive items and gear that can only be obtained during this festival event for this year! Once the festival starts on April 1, speak to the jester in the town of Riddari to play!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/a0a2525b6123f22e5fc24a35c9ffd3263fdcd38b.jpg[/img]

The event will last for only one week, so get in there and be foolish while the event lasts!


[h1]New Options Menu[/h1]

On the Foolish Fool's Day patch, there will be a new options menu that allows you greater control over some aspects of the gameplay of Einlanzer. This replaces the bottom menu option that let you quit the game. The option to end the game or return to the main menu is now at the bottom of the new options menu.

[b]New in the options menu:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Customize the window color
    [*]Adjust music, background sounds, and sound effects volumes
    [*]Allow for auto dash (highly requested in discussion board - I hadn't implemented this before because I needed to do extensive playtesting to make sure it didn't mess up scenes throughout the game)
    [*]Allow you to make text appear instantly
    [*]Disable battle animations (I have never liked this option in other games because it reduces immersion, but some like it apparently)
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/f5e5ad4265d5e55b349b62298c14cf648164ba7f.jpg[/img]


[h1]Two New Side Quests[/h1]

While there are many side quests in Einlanzer, people have asked for even more. I am currently working on two brand new, large side quests. They might not be ready for the April 1 update, but they will be completed soon.

[b]Ancient Fusilier Fort Side Quest[/b]
One side quest pays homage to the side quest from Final Fantasy 6 where you find the old castle buried under the mountains (where you got the Odin/Raiden esper). You will find an ancient Fusilier fort from before the first Yvalak war that's been buried underground. It will have new art, new monsters, a new dungeon, and a large new puzzle. Its challenge is geared toward Act 3, but the puzzle and many of the rewards will be suitable for wherever you are in the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/4e0025a49abeda2dfe9d3b9d7be7606c8da079a8.jpg[/img]

[b]Potion Ingredients Side Quest[/b]
The second new side quest will have you scouring Lanzer's realm for potion ingredients for a new potion maker in God's Grove in Canaan.

The reward will be a brand new standard usable item type that could drastically change battle strategies if you choose to use them. No screenshots yet, but most of the programming for it is already completed.


As always, thank you for playing. If you enjoy Einlanzer, please take a couple minutes to leave a review of the game. It helps tremendously!

Happy Adventuring!

-Andrew Ryan Henke

notes.title: Einlanzer v1.203 is live!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

Version 1.203 is now live!  This update has some fairly big balancing tweaks which I encourage you to read below.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/4f38880d6e7517d8fa56a7bd21ba18965196bb95.png[/img]
[h1]Buffed Armor and Magic Resist![/h1]
A general sense from most everyone who has played Einlanzer is that the armor does not quite make a big enough difference.  In this update, all headgear, bodygear, and defensive accessories have a 10% increase to their defense and magic resist.  Enjoy being more tanky! :-)

[h1]Reduced Enemy Speed[/h1]
Another general consensus from most players is that enemies are too fast - especially on hard.  Every enemy's speed has been reduced slightly to give you a better chance of being faster even if you don't have some Boots of Speed equipped.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/d9e25d00857bfcd4dfd2892521e36650de286ea8.png[/img]
[h1]Stronger Victor![/h1]
Victor's ultimate Rages Undying Rage and Perfect Rage were recently nerfed.  This was required to fix an invincible Victor build that wasn't intended to be a viable strategy.  In response, I have now buffed him in another way.  All classes, subclasses, and on all difficulties, Victor now has 10% more strength!  He now, by far, has the highest strength stat of any character by default.

[h1]Void Bow on Ratt Bug[/h1]
There was a bug with Ratt where you could equip the Void Bow and still have 100% accuracy.  Ratt's base accuracy is now 105% to fix this.

[h1]Buffed Provoke[/h1]
Lastly, the Provoke skill is a very important skill in Einlanzer, especially depending on how you build your characters.  A complaint was made that it didn't have enough effect.  Provoke used to buff a character's target rate by 600%, it now buffs it by 700%.  This effect DOES stack with Intimidation Broach (which doubles target rate to make Provoke now do 1,400%).

Happy adventuring!  Look for another small update soon with a new, beautifully made world map.

[u]If you haven't already, please take a couple minutes to write a review of Einlanzer.  It helps tremendously![/u]

[h1]Update Details:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Lowered every enemy's speed slightly
    [*]Made end boss (all forms) slightly less powerful
    [*]Buffed Victor's attack by 10% for all difficulties and subclasses
    [*]Lowered Ratt's accuracy to 105%.  This fixes the error with the Void bow being too accurate on him.
    [*]All armor has 10% more defense and magic resist.
    [*]Provoke buffed to multiplly user's target rate 700% now instead of 600%.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.201
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Einlanzer version 1.201![/b]

There are a lot of small but significant changes and additions to the game in this update.  Each change will be described in detail below:

[h1]New Rewards for Being Dishonorable[/h1]

There is a HUGE reward for making honorable decisions through the course of Einlanzer [spoiler]in the form of the powerful Excalibur late in the game[/spoiler], but there were few benefits to being dishonorable other than taking trinkets here and there when Alice/Galadin frowns upon it.  Now there are three distinct advantages to being dishonorable to balance the big reward for being honorable.

[b]New Vile Equipment[/b]
Previously, the strongest base item type in the game were "Diamond" weapons and armor.  In v1.201, there is now even more powerful "Vile" weapons and armor that are only available if you have been fairly consistently dishonorable.  They are not drastically more powerful than the Diamond weapons.  Also the weapons lower luck and HP, and the armor lowers luck and MP to balance the weapons a bit.  There is a new item seller of the Vile equipment in The Abyss after the Nightmare Gate.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/a4c66636ce2c706a18a3b6d7117d8f441384a394.jpg[/img]
[b]Diamond Equipment Seller in Canan[/b]
Previously, "Diamond" level equipment was not able to be obtained (except for a few chests) until the player reaches The Abyss.  Now, there is a way to purchase Diamond equipment in Canaan.  There is a new nixie added to the north section of Yggdrasil Woods.  This nixie will have an honor event (gain or lose some honor depending on your choices) and sell you Diamond equipment if she doesn't sense that you're a do-gooder like the angels.  In other words, if you have too many good deeds in your past, she won't sell you the gear.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/81288b13b1e623ac60eb54fc9e4a7900c3c7a8eb.jpg[/img]
[b]Masterwork Equipment Seller in Riddari Castle[/b]
Similar to the Vile and Diamond equipment, there is an event when you are inside the back halls of Riddari Castle where you have an option to purchase Masterwork gear earlier than normal.  You will not be given this opportunity if Finn thinks you're too good.

[h1]Victor's Invincible Rage Skills Rework[/h1]
A build has been discussed in the community for making Victor permanently invincible.  Previously, if you put enough RP building items on Vic, a Blessed Ribon, and used either Undying Rage or Perfect Rage, you could keep the invincible effect going permanently.  While it is fun to experiment and find strategic builds/equipment sets, this one was game-breaking.  You could do this build to defeat any enemy later in the game.  Also, while doing this strategy, battles would take FOREVER.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/abe3b950b657e9c7d5979f8bf0bc54c8f0432dcb.jpg[/img]
Victor's "Undying Rage" and "Perfect Rage" skills no longer add the invulnerable status effect.  Now, a "Damage Halved" status effect is applied for these skills.  Absolutely all damage Victor takes while this status effect is applied is halved (similar to Guard, but he can still take actions).  This will retain the original intention for these skills--Victor will still be a tanky behemoth, but the "Invincible Victor" strategy will be impossible.

[h1]Tiamat and Void Demon Rebalancing[/h1]
Partly because of the Victor rework, the last two enemies in the Colosseum have been rebalanced.  Players were having too much trouble defeating these bosses (this resulted in players figuring out and resorting to the Invincible Victor build).  Both enemies now have less offensive capabilities but more HP.  This will cause the fights to still be epic, strain your resources a bit more, but not be quite as difficult.

[h1]New Accessory that Lowers Encounter Rate[/h1]

Based on player feedback in the community, a new item has been added to the game.  In the massive corkscrew that leads to Yvalak's Chambers in The Abyss, there is one side path that leads to a group of treasure chests.  One formerly held a single, boring, tent.  Now, this chest contains the "Crystal of Warding," an accessory that raises magic power, magic defense, and luck slightly.  It's primary function is that it halves the amount of random encounters that occur.

This item is given very late in the game for a specific reason.  Once this point in the game is reached, there are basically no more dungeons to traverse (except the secret epic difficulty dungeon).  If players want to go to previous dungeons and explore, this item will allow this to be done without having to fight nearly as many time-consuming, easy enemies.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/f9281fa7d044b8fda11d7b6de06779494c109724.jpg[/img]
[h1]Aesthetic Changes to The Abyss[/h1]
The Abyss is supposed to be a whole new realm with living, intelligent creatures.  Previously, it felt more like simply the last dungeon.  Many things have been added to The Abyss to help establish a living-breathing realm-like feel.  Abyss monster NPCs have been added throughout The Abyss that you can talk to.  Most have unique dialogue that let you have a deeper idea of how Abyss creatures live and think.  Also, floating jellyfish overhead have been added to most areas of The Abyss to make it feel even more atmospheric.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/8c12189cfdbacd61b77b4966d551ebd968e607cf.jpg[/img]
As always, please spend a couple minutes writing a review of Einlanzer.  It helps tremendously!

Enjoy!
-Andrew Ryan Henke
Nostalgia Addict Games


[h1]Update Details[/h1]

[list]
    [*]New "Vile" weapons and armor added
    [*]Seller of Vile equipment added in Abyss after Nightmare Gate
    [*]Seller of Diamond equipment added in North section of Yggdrasil Woods
    [*]Seller of Masterwork equipment added in back halls of Riddari Castle
    [*]Reworked Victor's Undying Rage and Perfect Rage skill.  They no longer add make him unable to be killed.  They now make him take 1/2 damage from all damage types.
    [*]Reworded the descriptions for all of Victor's Rage skills to be more clear what they do.
    [*]Tiamat and Void Demon - less offensive power, more HP
    [*]Added Crystal of Warding item which halves random enemy encounter rate.  This item is obtainable in the corkscrew down to Yvalak's Chambers in The Abyss.
    [*]Added many NPCs in The Abyss
    [*]Added floating jellyfish overhead in many areas of The Abyss
    [*]Fixed a couple non-vital typos.
[/list]

Victor's "Undying Rage" and "Perfect Rage" skills no longer add the invulnerable status effect.  Now, a "Damage Halved" status effect is applied for these skills. [h1]Tiamat and Void Demon Rebalancing[/h1]
Partly because of the Victor rework, the last two enemies in the Colosseum have been rebalanced.  Players were having too much trouble defeating these bosses (this resulted in players figuring out and resorting to the Invincible Victor build). Based on player feedback in the community, a new item has been added to the game.  In the massive corkscrew that leads to Yvalak's Chambers in The Abyss, there is one side path that leads to a group of treasure chests.  One formerly held a single, boring, tent.  Now, this chest contains the "Crystal of Warding," an accessory that raises magic power, magic defense, and luck slightly.  It's primary function is that it halves the amount of random encounters that occur.

This item is given very late in the game for a specific reason.  Once this point in the game is reached, there are basically no more dungeons to traverse (except the secret epic difficulty dungeon). The Abyss is supposed to be a whole new realm with living, intelligent creatures.  Previously, it felt more like simply the last dungeon.  Many things have been added to The Abyss to help establish a living-breathing realm-like feel.  Abyss monster NPCs have been added throughout The Abyss that you can talk to.  Most have unique dialogue that let you have a deeper idea of how Abyss creatures live and think.  Also, floating jellyfish overhead have been added to most areas of The Abyss to make it feel even more atmospheric.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/8c12189cfdbacd61b77b4966d551ebd968e607cf.jpg[/img]

Nostalgia Addict Games

notes.title: Einlanzer v. 1.200 - Full Controller Support!
notes.content:
[h1]Full Controller Support![/h1]
Since the release of Einlanzer, many users have complained that their PC gamepads, Xbox 360 controllers, etc. did not work.  This is now fixed!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/54a7095a2b174de7734b4bea4fdf786d66090646.png[/img]

When you launch Einlanzer, you will now have two options: Keyboard/Steam Controller optimization or PC Gamepad optimization.

[u]EXTREMELY IMPORTANT[/u]
[i]If you prefer using the keyboard or Steam controller, you can ignore this....[/i]

[b]If you have already started playing Einlanzer and want to now use the new PC gamepad version, you must copy your save game files and paste them in a new directory.[/b] How to do this is described below.  Once this is done, your save files are exclusive to the two versions of the game.

Already started Einlanzer and you want to swap to the PC gamepad version?  Follow these steps:
[list]
    [*]Go to your Steam directory. 
       It is usually C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam
       Or...
       C:/Program Files/Steam
    [*]Navigate through the Steam directory.  Follow this path:
       ..Steam/steamapps/common/Einlanzer/Savegames
    [*]Now copy all of your save games (select them all and press ctrl+c)
    [*]Now navigate to a new file by following this path:
       ..Einlanzer/PCGamepad/Einlanzer/Savegames/
    [*]Now paste (ctrl+v) and you are done!
    [*]Boot up Einlanzer, select the PC Gamepad version, and your save game files will be there ready to go.  Steam cloud saves will act like normal, but again, the PC gamepad and the Keyboard/Steam Controller versions are like seperate games.  The save files will not transfer between the two versions.  In other words, once your save game files are in the right place, keep playing the same version or you'll have to copy and paste back and forth.
[/list]

I know this is not a PERFECT fix, but as long as you follow the above steps and don't swap between versions, it'll work just fine.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/0427fed4f0d9c5a7c44644800736f7e19589c304.png[/img]

[h1]Update Details[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added new launch option to play Einlanzer with PC gamepad optimization
    [*]Exclusive for PC Gamepad version: Created new controller guide images at the start of a new game to correspond with PC gamepads, Xbox 360 controllers, and PS3 controllers
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.111
notes.content:
[h1]New Blessed Ribbon event![/h1]
Undeniably one of the most important items in the game is the rare Blessed Ribbon, which prevents almost all status effects from being applied to the character wearing the accessory.

In an effort to teach the player how important and powerful the Blessed Ribbon is, a new event has been added.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/85120f7c3e787f6798a4745df05c805b636a6506.jpg[/img]

A nixie is present at the forest Lanzer Day statue southeast of Alabaster.  If you talk to her, she leads you on a wild chase through the surrounding forests.  Following her and surmounting her tricks will grant you a Blessed Ribbon MUCH earlier in the game that was previously possible.  This also brings the total number of Blessed Ribbons in the game up to four (though one is only available after the secret super difficult extra end boss).

[h1]Reworked "Plains of Balance" skill[/h1]
The skill you are able to learn from the plains gem called "Plains of Balance" previously allowed a character to sacrifice 50 RP to grant any party member 100 RP.  This had two problems....  First, a character could do this ability on themselves, then do it two more times to feed ridiculous amounts of RP to his/her allies.  This was not the intention of the skill.  Second, in the course of the game, this was the first skill learned from the Lanzer Day statues.  Early on, not only do characters not have abilities that need 100 RP, but it was confusing for players.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/16d33f97f8f61e15af917f3edf6099e8058a123c.jpg[/img]

The Plains of Balance skill has been completely reworked.  It now erases all debuffs for the whole party, removes some status effects (stun, paralyze, poison, and confusion), and grants a magic defense buff for 3 rounds.  This makes it much more versatile and gives the unique ability to remove a whole party's debuffs.  It's also more easy to understand for players near the beginning of the game.

Thank you as always for all the positive feedback.  If you enjoy Einlanzer, please spend a few minutes reviewing the game on Steam!  It helps tremendously.

Happy adventuring!
[url=www.einlanzergame.com]http:\\www.einlanzergame.com[/url]


[h1]Update Details[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added nixie event in the forest Lanzer Day statue area southeast of Alabaster where player is now able to earn a "Blessed Ribbon" item much earlier in the game
    [*]Fixed several more typos in various places
    [*]Completely reworked the "Plains of Balance" skill
    [*]Made all forms of the end boss slightly less powerful
    [*]Final end boss form no longer causes "Slow" status effect with regular attacks
    [*]Lowered the attack power and speed of the "Walking Dead" enemy
    [*]Increased MP cost for Diviner Alice's "Starlight" ability by 1 and decreased power slightly
    [*]Reworked Galadin's "resist 20% physical attacks" to incorporate all kinds of physical attacks, not just abilities with the "physical attack" element.  This will make her now resist almost anything that isn't a spell.
    [*]Buffed Null-Magic Mantle and Negatron Cloak to give even more magic defense
    [*]Made the "Gold Nixie" enemy slightly easier to hit with spells, have less magic power, and does "Escape" slightly less often.  It also now gives 500 more XP and 1000 more GP.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Update - 1.107
notes.content:
[h1]New Detail Stats Screen[/h1]
For a more clear representation of a character's stats, I've added a "Detail Stats" screen under "Status" in the menu.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27377919/b420cf3908cd153d74baece3c694d65dd8df26c1.jpg[/img]
No more wondering exactly how much evasion Finn has with all those fancy evasion boosting items... this screen will tell you exactly.

One confusing thing is the difference between "RP Regen" and "RP Charge"

RP Regen is the more common stat.  It is what the strength belts raise, the Karati Gis, and most other items.  It's simply a number between 0 and 100, meaning that is how much RP you will gain passively each round.

RP Charge is when you get hit by an attack or ability, how much RP you will gain.  For example, with the "Rage Belt" item, you get 50% more RP Charge when attacked.  So, if an attack would give you 20 RP normally, with the Rage Belt equipped, you'd gain 30 RP.

[h1]Update Details:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added "Detail Stats" option under "Status" in the menu
    [*]Added 25% RP Charge to "Headband of Fury" accessory
    [*]Fixed bug where a player got stuck in the discount item shop in Nynnyaw
    [*]Changed Ratt's description to be more clear about "Pinned" status
    [*]Gave Silver a description
    [*]Buffed Silver to gain 5 RP each round, and 50% bonus RP when attacked.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.103
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Achievement issues fix[/h1]
People have been having occasional issues with Steam Achievements being earned in game but not showing up on Steam.  Also, in the past, if you earn an achievement while not online, the game had no way of telling Steam you earned it.  This update will fix the issue.

Now, each time you earn an achievement, you will earn a key item related to that Achievement.  For example, defeating the Orc King will earn you the key item "Trophy - Stumbling Victory!" which corresponds to the Achievement.

A sleeping man has been added to the inn in the town of Alm.  This man will update your Steam Achievements based on which trophy key items you have.  You can talk to this man as many times as you like if you ever have issues.

This will make it so you can still earn the achievement on Steam even if you earn the achievement in the game while not online or when it glitches and doesn't communicate with Steam correctly.

If you have already started a game, the first time you talk to the sleeping man in Alm, it will automatically give you all of the key items associated with your earned achievements.


[h1]Seasonal Events[/h1]
I'm planning on implementing seasonal, temporary update events to Einlanzer.  For example, on Halloween, I might have wearable costumes that change character's appearances... or collectible unique candy items you can turn in for items.  There might even be an April Fool's day update in a few days... we'll see... ;-)

Enjoy!

[h1]Introducing Subclasses![/h1]

*Devotee - Healing on self works 25% more, +10% defense and magic defense

[u]Thief[/u]
Assassin - every attack has 1% chance of instant kill
Treasure Hunter - double item drop chances, double chance of going twice in a round
*Ninja - base 10% evasion and crit chance

[u]Mage[/u]

*Blink Warlock - gain 10% evasion and magic evasion

[u]Monk[/u]
*Ki Master - gain 20% magic attack and MP
Wu Xing - 5 animal forms, 5 rounds, 20RP (Dragon - attk + mattk stats buffed, Crane - +50% evasion and immune to ground attacks, Tiger - extra attack, Snake - counterattack raised to 67% and 2x provoke, Monkey - double speed and regen MP)
Xiao Lin - +10% Attack, Defense, and Magic Defense

[u]Paladin[/u]
*Runic Knight - Gains 10% magic reflection
Healer - Gains 10% magic attack and casts Recovery spells
Cleric - Gains 5% counterattack, Can use blunt and gain those skills

[u]Spellsword[/u]
*Time mage - Attacks have 10% chance to cause slow, immune to slow
Sage - can use staves
Warrior - Able to wear heavy armor and shields, +10% attack

[u]Dancer[/u]
Rogue - Cannot wield bows, loses bow skills, can wield two daggers, gain Flurry of Daggers skills, +10% attack
Archer - +10% attack and more bow skills
*Scholar - +20% magic attack, +60 MP

[u]Hunter[/u]
Debilitator - break skills have 90% chance of working instead of 67%
Woodsman - use small shields and gain axe skills
*Deadshot - base +15% crit chance

Succubus - slow, slow II spells, Nightmare, Dark Wrath abilities, +10% magic attack and MP[/spoiler]

*Tyrant - All stats 10% better
Fighter - Learns all of the strongst attacking skills, not most
Wizard - Learns all of the strongest spells, not most

Each character now has a static Luck stat that will protect them from status effects.  For example, unless you use "Luck Up" items on Finn, his Luck stat will be 400 for the entire game. Enjoy!
